findings.narrativeExcerpt: A provision required five years of continuous residence before the claimant could receive title, making residence a condition of the path from claim to ownership.
findings.relation: The provision makes five years of continuous residence a prerequisite to receiving title; it does not assert that residence began only after the claim.
findings.evidenceExcerpt: Among its provisions was a five-year requirement of continuous residence before receiving the title to the land

candidates: The story is about the link between making a land claim and receiving ownership title. A provision required five years of continuous residence before the claimant could receive title, making residence a condition of the path from claim to ownership. The reader should understand that a claim alone did not immediately confer title under this provision.
- **Endpoint:** Clarify that the provision made ownership title contingent on meeting that residence requirement.
- **Context:** Introduce the subject as a land claim that could lead to ownership title.
